name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=play, descriptor=palette_fade_in). No Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects behavior: the loop walks brightness_subtract 0x40 -> 0, taking the screen from BLACK to FULL brightness = fade-IN. Consistent with sibling fd2_play_palette_fade_to_black @ 0x1f882.
purpose: VGA palette fade-IN: ramps the screen from black up to full brightness over ~7.2s, used as the reveal transition at chapter-intro / cinematic / ending hooks.
logic_summary: for (subtract = 0x40; subtract >= 0; subtract--) { fd2_set_vga_palette_range(0, 0xFF, subtract); fd2_delay_ms(2); }. fd2_set_vga_palette_range writes max(0, base[i]-subtract) to all 256 DAC entries, so subtract=0x40 -> all channels clamp to 0 (BLACK) and subtract=0 -> base palette unchanged (FULL). 0x41 iterations x ~2 BIOS ticks (~110ms) ~= 7.2s. (Ghidra's __CHK(0x14) is the compiler stack-probe prologue, not game logic.)

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect only: writes the VGA DAC range 0..0xFF repeatedly while ramping brightness from black to full, blocking ~7.2s.
